description: Implementation of the egl::Stream class managing streaming frames, including creation, acquisition, release, and texture management, within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a streaming object managing frame buffers, textures, and synchronization for EGL streams within ANGLE.

methods.name: Stream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with display and attributes.

methods.name: ~Stream
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and textures.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets a label for the stream.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the stream.

methods.name: setConsumerLatency
methods.description: Sets the consumer latency in microseconds.

methods.name: getConsumerLatency
methods.description: Returns the consumer latency.

methods.name: getProducerFrame
methods.description: Returns the current producer frame number.

methods.name: getConsumerFrame
methods.description: Returns the current consumer frame number.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the stream.

methods.name: setConsumerAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Sets the acquire timeout for the consumer.

methods.name: getConsumerAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Returns the acquire timeout.

methods.name: getProducerType
methods.description: Returns the producer type.

methods.name: getConsumerType
methods.description: Returns the consumer type.

methods.name: getPlaneCount
methods.description: Returns the number of planes.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the stream producer implementation.

methods.name: createConsumerGLTextureExternal
methods.description: Creates a consumer GL texture external based on attributes.

methods.name: createProducerD3D11Texture
methods.description: Creates a D3D11 texture producer.

methods.name: consumerAcquire
methods.description: Called when the consumer starts using the stream, acquires images.

methods.name: consumerRelease
methods.description: Releases images when consumer is done.

methods.name: isConsumerBoundToContext
methods.description: Checks if the consumer is bound to a specific GL context.

methods.name: validateD3D11Texture
methods.description: Validates a D3D11 texture.

methods.name: postD3D11Texture
methods.description: Posts a D3D11 texture to the stream.

methods.name: releaseTextures
methods.description: Releases all textures associated with the stream.
